text_block_list.text:
Matikane Fukukitaru said there was a place
she wanted to stop by before heading home, so I followed her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! Let's go bungee jumping☆
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see! Today's pair fortune said,
'Bungee jumping brings good luck'...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And besides!
Just look at that slogan!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Desperate Situation?! Sky-Reaching Mystic Bungee"
...In other words, you can reach the domain of the gods—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... that bungee jump was way too crazy.
I thought my soul was gonna leave my body...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hyehh!? My soul is leaving my body!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Divination is like a promise
to Lady Shiraoki! I must see it through no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I brought along
a special good luck charm!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Its name is... the "Leave 1 HP Charm"!
Blessed with protection that lets you survive any blow by a hair!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's originally a good luck charm for gaming,
but I figured it'd be perfect for getting out of a desperate pinch."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With this, our souls won't get sucked out, probably.
Absolutely, most likely, maybe... it'll totally be fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on! Let's go together
and show them what our duo is made of...!
choice_data_list: ...It's enough if I'm the only one who goes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on! Let's go together
and show them what our duo is made of...!
choice_data_list: ...It's enough if I'm the only one who goes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes!! Let's get this done in two shakes of a lamb's tail!

And so, we lined up for the bungee jump
and waited for our turn... And finally—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eek... What is this height?!
Forget reaching the heavens, I feel like I'm about to be summoned there?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees~! Steel your resolve...
Namu spinach, namu spinach!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I thought fortune slips
were going to come out of my mouth...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hahh... Thank you... so much... for keeping me company...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Had you not been there, Trainer,
my spirit would have broken and my soul drained away...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe the fortune was hinting at this.
Like, forming a strong bond with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
“—And on that note! Without further ado,
it seems the time has come to test that bond!”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Fuku-chan is completely exhausted with only 1 HP left, so please nurse her back to health with your bond!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A piggyback and a carry! Ah,
I think taking a cab is also an option!

...'If we are to test our bond,
shouldn't we overcome the trial together?'
With that thought, she headed home on foot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? D-Don't tell me...
To show our duo's strong bond by putting myself on the line, or something!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You can't do that!
Not if it means sacrificing Trainer-san!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...!
To think you'd be prepared to go that far for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Understood... Two hearts beating as one, surely Lady Shiraoki will be pleased as well!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
I entrust you with my feelings and this charm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is a handmade charm from me, so good fortune is...
guaranteed to come your way!
And so, I stood in line for the bungee jump in place of Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Here we go~!
...Let's! BUNGEE!!
—...also... help... me...—
—..."Please continue to watch over her..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Welcome back!
Are you okay? Did your soul get sucked out or something?

For just a second, I saw strange sights and heard mysterious voices, but...
it seems I finished the bungee jump safely.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, thank goodness. While I was waiting,
I felt half to death with worry, you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I know! I figured being at 1 HP must be rough, so I bought all sorts of things while I was waiting!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nutritious carrot juice, along with
a celebratory-looking taiyaki...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Also, please wear this wish ribbon
I won at the crane game... I mean, tested my luck for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've already checked the bus times for the way back,
so please, take your time and enjoy yourself here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's just a token
of my gratitude to you, Trainer!
Moved by the surprisingly gentle nursing care from the usually wild and unpredictable Matikanefukukitaru... I headed back to the Academy.
